The findings do not test or report an item at exactly its reorder point being shown as OK instead of low.
The failed shipment attempt used quantity 1 while PNL-A3 had 7 on hand, not a shipment of the entire on-hand quantity. It therefore does not establish the full-stock off-by-one refusal.
